summary: Comprehensive architectural implementation plan to evolve Talksy into a full-scale community platform. Covers top-bar navigation with full-screen views (Chats, Feed, Groups, Friends, Profiles), 24h horizontal Stories tray, rich social posts with reactions and comments, Group communities with admin/moderator roles, friend requests and mutual connections, real-time notification drawer, and privacy/safety controls with Admin Zayan invite-code governance.
